name.km: បបរផ្អែមសាគូពោត
name.en: Sweet Coconut Soup with Pearl Sago & Corn

description: A warm Khmer sweet soup of pearl sago & corn in pandan-scented coconut milk.
descriptionKm: បបរផ្អែមសាគូពោត ក្នុងទឹកដូងស្លឹកតើយ។

ingredients.notesKm: ស្ម័គ្រ សម្រាប់រាងក្រាស់

instructions.text: Simmer the pearl sago & corn in water with pandan until soft.
Add palm sugar and a pinch of salt; stir until dissolved.
Pour in the coconut milk and warm through gently without hard-boiling.
instructions.tip: Boiling can split the coconut milk — keep it at a gentle simmer.

instructions.text: Serve warm or over ice as a sweet dessert soup (bong-aem).
